note: Derived from the tree by the build-coverage command in tools/accounting-skills. Do not edit by hand. The native CI job and the coverage-matrix pre-commit hook rebuild this file and fail on any difference. The reviewed field is the earliest recorded human review date across the sources for a skill. The fetched field is the earliest of their last recorded retrieval-attempt dates. A retrieval is not a human review. The reviewed_count field is how many of the indexed sources carry a human review date. The confirmed_pass and confirmed_fail fields list the skill's cards with a human-confirmed verdict in validation/results whose rubric digest matches the card as it is now; confirmed_noncurrent_digest lists cards with a confirmed verdict whose rubric digest does not match the current card, whether or not the current card also has a verdict; the card's history is not checked. One card version confirmed both pass and fail is refused, as is a status other than prepared, observed or confirmed. Legacy records without a status are not counted.
